newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian International Brachytherapy IPO closed.
newsitem.headline: Belgian International Brachytherapy IPO closed.

text.p: The initial public offering of 250,000 shares in cancer treatment drug developer International Brachytherapy (IBt) was slightly oversubscribed, lead managers Belgian brokerage Smeets, Verbaet & Co said on Monday.
"We had applications for 255,000 shares," Steven Sarens of Smeets' corporate finance department told Reuters. The issue closed on Friday.
Applicants would be notified of their shareholdings in the coming days. "We will give preference to small, private shareholders," Sarens said.
IBt is destined to become the first share to be quoted on Brussels' new Euro.NM market for small growth stocks.
"Listing should take place in the second half of March," Sarens said. No date had yet been fixed, he added.

The Euro.NM market is an initiative involving the Paris, Frankfurt, Brussels and Amsterdam stock exchanges. The market is aimed at attracting small, growing companies and competing with rival markets, such as the Brussels-based, Europe-wide Easdaq exchange and London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM).
